initiative.title: Useful, configurable maps for location data
initiative.summary: Improve point and region maps, custom and supplied geography, render controls, and detailed local context without building a full GIS.
initiative.next_action: Byron reviews the plan; then start milestone 1.

claims.statement: Street maps work for paying customers with no key, no configuration, and no tiles maintained by Byron or hosts.
claims.notes: Answers 2, 4. Hosts may substitute a provider.

claims.statement: Infer the useful geography level from the data, allow override, and show finer detail on zoom.
Include world countries and US states/counties by default if small; other geography is opt-in per host so installs do not grow for non-map users.
Provide a point-to-region calculation computed locally on demand, not saved; persistence awaits a future write-back augmentation pass.
Group crowded points into clusters that split on zoom; draw a couple of thousand points directly.
Choose projection by extent: equal-area for world views, web map with streets for regional and local views.
PNG export includes streets; shared views restore through saved settings only, without URL view parameters.
claims.notes: Answer 3. Offline street maps not required.

claims.statement: React 18 support must not block the right street engine; React 19 is acceptable.

conflicts.description: Research proposes one country pack first; the user wants more supplied geography.
conflicts.resolution: Resolved by product answers: ship countries, worldwide admin-1, and US counties up front through a companion package.

conflicts.description: Leaflet was a user hypothesis. Research identifies vector label controls as a possible reason to choose MapLibre.
conflicts.resolution: Resolved by product answers: free no-key vector tiles (OpenFreeMap) imply MapLibre; Leaflet core remains a fallback, React 19 only if React Leaflet is used.

conflicts.description: The Pro proof plan includes checkout, camera, fallback, and compatibility proposals beyond settled intent.
conflicts.resolution: Apply the limits in references/research-reconciliation.md. No new worktree, compatibility platform, or unapproved implementation follows from the report.

shape.appetite: Three shippable releases: (1) trustworthy selection, values, import; (2) supplied boundaries, level inference, Locate region, content controls; (3) street basemap, clustering, export.
shape.problem: Maps need too much setup and have suspected selection faults: no ready boundaries beyond land, no level inference, no street context, and no handling for crowded points.
shape.recommended_shape: Keep D3/SVG for world extents and hand off to MapLibre GL (optional peer) with OpenFreeMap styles for regional and local views; include world countries and US states/counties lazily, with opt-in packs for other geography; compute Locate region on demand in a worker; cluster crowded points.

success_moves.move: Use MapLibre GL directly (no React wrapper) with OpenFreeMap as the default style.
success_moves.risk_reduced: No key, no tiles to maintain, built-in clustering and canvas export; React 18 support unaffected.
success_moves.evidence: openfreemap.org: no key, no limits, commercial use allowed, vector tiles, MapLibre auto-attribution; ToS: may discontinue without notice.

success_moves.move: Key all selection by source row ID across D3 and MapLibre, including cluster leaves.
success_moves.risk_reduced: Prevents renderer feature IDs from changing what a selection means.
success_moves.evidence: Research P06; existing planners already own row identity.

success_moves.move: Always keep the D3 outline map as the fallback when tiles fail or a host disables streets.
success_moves.risk_reduced: OpenFreeMap has no SLA; no blank maps.

success_moves.move: Include only world-atlas countries-110m and us-atlas states/counties (about 1.06 MB raw, 330 KB gzipped), loaded lazily; other geography through opt-in packs registered by the host.
success_moves.risk_reduced: Keeps installs small for users who never map; avoids a sprawling boundary catalog.
success_moves.evidence: Measured from world-atlas 2.0.2 and us-atlas 3.0.1 tarballs on 2026-10-11.

success_moves.move: Compute Locate region on demand in a worker with a Flatbush bounds index, once per distinct coordinate, cached per session.
success_moves.risk_reduced: Acceptable speed without persisting derived data.

success_moves.move: Reproduce the empty-space clear and draft-Escape faults as failing tests first.
success_moves.risk_reduced: Confirms baseline correctness before new engines build on it.

first_proof.question: Can a D3 world view hand off to a MapLibre street view without losing place, filters, exact row selection, keyboard use, or export?
first_proof.artifact: Spike on the earthquakes demo: lazily loaded MapLibre with an OpenFreeMap style beneath the chart frame, handoff at a zoom threshold, clustered points, PNG export. Record handoff behavior, cluster selection IDs, keyboard selection, PNG contents and credits, and lazy bundle cost.
first_proof.decision_rule: Smooth handoff and exact IDs: build release 3 this way. Jarring handoff: use MapLibre at every extent and drop equal-area world views.

rabbit_holes: Handoff between two renderers: camera mapping, transition feel, and dual focus models.
Accessible keyboard path over WebGL marks and clusters.
Level inference false positives (e.g. numeric codes that look like FIPS).
OpenFreeMap discontinuation or CORS changes; export canvas tainting.
Saved references to supplied boundaries when the package version changes.
Coarse 110m country polygons leave coastal points unlocated.
MapLibre install size (about 28 MB unpacked) versus the small-install goal.

milestones.title: Map selection behaves like other charts
milestones.outcome: Draft Escape and empty-space click are fixed; region zero/no-rows/invalid/unmatched states are distinct.
milestones.proof: Failing-then-passing vitest in pointMap/regionMap tests; planner fixture; screenshots at 3 widths.
milestones.rollback: Revert the PR; no saved-data change.

milestones.title: Street view hands off from the world map (proof)
milestones.outcome: Earthquakes demo zooms from D3 world view into a MapLibre street view keeping place, filters, and exact selection.
milestones.proof: Camera round-trip unit tests; demo browser check; Playwright request blocking shows outline fallback; lazy chunk size measured.
milestones.valid_intermediate_state: Hosts without a registered engine see no change.
milestones.rollback: Remove the registration; tagged camera keeps legacy views valid.

milestones.title: Boundary import explains itself
milestones.outcome: Located validation errors, counts, no half-added imports, richer join preview.
milestones.proof: Malformed fixture tests; throwing callback leaves assets unchanged.
milestones.valid_intermediate_state: Import path improved; nothing else changes.

milestones.title: Countries and US boundaries just work
milestones.outcome: Built-in countries, US states, US counties via BoundaryRegistry; host packs; saved references by id and version.
milestones.proof: Choropleth demos; validateSavedData tests; missing-pack state; install and chunk size measured.
milestones.valid_intermediate_state: Imported assets keep working; references are additive.
milestones.rollback: Remove built-in sets; saved references show missing-pack state.

milestones.title: The map picks the level, and points can find their region
milestones.outcome: inferMapLevel picks the level; region() calculation locates points on demand; zoom shows finer levels.
milestones.proof: Inference unit tests; 50k-row timing spike; demo opens on correct level.
milestones.rollback: Remove the function; saved expressions report an unknown function.

milestones.title: Choose what the map shows
milestones.outcome: Content popover controls marks, labels, reference boundaries, and basemap without changing filters or joins.
milestones.proof: Tests that content changes leave filters/joins; service-district demo screenshots.
milestones.rollback: Revert; new settings optional in validation.

milestones.title: Crowded points and street export
milestones.outcome: Clusters on both renderers select exact rows; PNG export includes streets and credits.
milestones.proof: 50k earthquake demo; cluster selection IDs; PNG at 1x and 2x.
milestones.rollback: Disable clustering threshold; export falls back to outline.
